reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: policy 'Allow read access for all users' (USING true) is confirmed live at 0001_create_attendance_schema.sql:67, and the fix migration 20260317000001 explicitly re-grants SELECT on attendance.temp_registrations to anon (L87) without adding a column-level restriction or expiry filter. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined; attack vector is the unauthenticated public PostgREST endpoint. Gate 3: supabase/migrations/ is in-scope and QR registration flow vulnerabilities are listed as key concerns. An attacker can trigger this via the PostgREST REST endpoint (GET /rest/v1/temp_registrations?select=qr_token,card_id with anon key) and retrieve all active bearer tokens, then visit /register/STOLEN_TOKEN while authenticated, causing completeRegistration to link the attacker's auth identity to the victim's card_id and enabling forged attendance records as the victim.
